column8: Not a push-up, and not counted. On the video you are on your hands and knees, getting into position; the app was still counting and today refused it with "Go lower". Nothing in the counter changed: no reading I tried (torso angle, view) separates such moments from a real rep reliably yet, so they stay refused with words meant for a rep. The clip now runs 0:50.6–0:53.3 (it used to start at 0:50.4). "other" is the label for a moment that is not a push-up.
